title: Bust field parameters
description: Parameters of the bind-space bust deformation field (web/src/core/field.js DEFAULT_PARAMS; Python port tools/bustfield/field.py). All lengths are in S units (S = distance between the two upper-arm joints in bind space). Body frame: x = left (away from the midline on the left side), y = up, z = forward. Brush ops are in the side frame relative to the apex: x = outward (away from the midline, mirrored per side), y = up, z = forward. Each op of a target is applied to both sides (mirror symmetry by construction). Keys starting with '$' or '_' are reserved for metadata and ignored by the field.

anchor.description: Base centre of each breast in the body frame relative to the chest origin: x = distance from the midline, y = up, z = forward. The apex is `depth` in front of it.

depth.description: Base centre -> apex distance along the body forward axis.

window.description: Compact C2 window around each base centre (side-frame radii) with plateau fractions before the smootherstep falloff. The field is exactly zero outside it.

midline.description: Half-width of the midline blend band (left/right partition of unity). Default 0.1.

midlineLock.description: Width of the band where lateral motion is scaled by t(2 - t), t = |x| / midlineLock (0 disables). Default 0.15.

kernel.description: Brush kernel: regularized Kelvinlets (tri-scale) or the non-physical smootherstep baseline.

targets.description: Blend shape name -> list of brush ops (summed, then windowed). Standard names: bust_size_up_natural, bust_size_up_stylized, bust_size_down, bust_lift_up, bust_lift_down, bust_spread_out, bust_spread_in.

mask.description: Skin-weight mask applied at bake time (deltas are multiplied by 1 - weight on excluded bones).

nu.description: Poisson ratio of the brush medium. Scale brushes vanish at 0.5 (an incompressible medium cannot dilate).

grab.description: Grab brush: displacement `d` exactly at the centre `at`, decaying with radius `radius` (regularization eps).

scale.description: Scale (dilation) brush: u ~= k * r near the centre (k = 0.3 => +30% locally).
